headline: Chest-high SSE windswell with a clean morning window before the sea breeze fills in.
today: Best surf of the week is this morning — 2-3ft at a fair angle with light NNW to N offshore holding through the early hours off the low tide. Get on it before noon because the SE cross-onshore kicks in the afternoon and mushes it out. Fish or groveler to keep it moving; a log works too if it stays soft.

daysToWatch.note: Drops to 2ft but SE swings to a good angle and dawn/morning winds are light — clean little log session early before the SSE onshore builds through the afternoon.
Marginal SSE angle at short 4-5s period plus cross winds all day. Junky — low expectations.
